# QEONIX

> QEONIX designs, engineers, and deploys intelligent systems — AI, robotics, and smart-city infrastructure — for governments and enterprises. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Tagline: "Live Tomorrow, Today."

QEONIX brings the physical and digital worlds together to create smarter, more responsive systems for governments, organizations, and cities. Solutions are delivered as integrated, real-world systems built around a client's existing infrastructure, operating conditions, and the people who use them.

## What QEONIX does
- Intelligence & AI: artificial intelligence, generative & agentic AI, data & analytics
- Autonomous Systems: robotics, drones, connected mobility
- Smart Environments: connected, intelligent infrastructure for buildings, communities, and cities

## Industries served
Transportation & mobility, energy & utilities, industrial & manufacturing, logistics & supply chain, aviation & aerospace, construction & infrastructure, healthcare, and real estate & urban development.

## Approach
Understand, Design, Engineer, Integrate, Deploy, Evolve — aligning technical design with operational requirements and existing systems.
